rules.name: PostgreSQL — Privilege Escalation via SET ROLE
rules.description: Detects PostgreSQL SET ROLE attempts for privilege escalation
rules.aql_query: SELECT sourceip, destinationip, URL, payload FROM events WHERE (payload ILIKE '%postgresql%' OR payload ILIKE '%privilege-escalation%') GROUP BY sourceip, destinationip, URL LAST 15 MINUTES
